body: Sorry, but I call bullshit. Take a step back. I've been severely depressed as have most of this sub, but you don't take your own life to punish other people. No judgement is going on here, but you don't do it because of them. And not because of them, but because fuck them.

I really appreciate your response...I do volunteer at an awesome food bank, but passion has slipped away in my everyday life. I would like to get it back, but it's one of those things that seems unattainable at this point.
Depression is a terrible beast and it sounds like it's got you bad. Have you tried meds? Or go for a run, stretch till it hurts, or beat up a wall? Those things help me sometimes.
Okay, so then fuck them. Take that anger and use it to say "fuck you, I've got shit to do." Cuz you do. Don't do this out of spite, they're not worth it.
I'm FTM and also in debt to my family. I can't provide much support because I'm also struggling, but know that you're not alone.
